comments.content: I have just stumbled on your work and, as an old Level 9 gamer, I have to say I can't wait to get stuck in to making something. It's a real shame you aren't getting more attention for what you have achieved tbh. Have you considered appraoching someone like Waterstones to be put as a feature on their main site? They would get free value content and you would obviously benefit from higher footfall/ exposure. Win/ win really. Anyhow, which ever road you take, don't give up :)
